by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C D _ hs hpar
  rw [AffineSubspace.affineSpan_pair_parallel_iff_vectorSpan_eq, vectorSpan_pair_rev, vectorSpan_pair_rev] at hpar
  have m1 : C -ᵥ D ∈ Submodule.span ℝ {B -ᵥ A} := by rw [hpar]; exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp m1
  have hkpos : 0 < k := by
    by_contra hk0
    rcases (not_lt.mp hk0).lt_or_eq with hneg | hz
    · have hD : D = (-k) • (B -ᵥ A) +ᵥ C := by
        rw [neg_smul, hk, neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev, vsub_vadd]
      have h3 := AffineSubspace.sSameSide_smul_vsub_vadd_left (s := line[ℝ, A, C]) hs.2.1
        (left_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A C) (right_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A C) (neg_pos.mpr hneg)
      rw [← hD] at h3
      exact h3.symm.not_sOppSide hs
    · rw [hz, zero_smul] at hk
      exact hs.2.2 (vsub_eq_zero_iff_eq.mp hk.symm ▸ right_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ A C)
  have hMN : midpoint ℝ B C -ᵥ midpoint ℝ A D = ((1 + k) / 2) • (B -ᵥ A) := by
    rw [midpoint_vsub_midpoint, midpoint_eq_smul_add, ← hk, invOf_eq_inv]
    module
  have hpos : 0 < (1 + k) / 2 := by positivity
  constructor
  · rw [AffineSubspace.affineSpan_pair_parallel_iff_vectorSpan_eq, vectorSpan_pair_rev, vectorSpan_pair_rev, hMN]
    exact Submodule.span_singleton_smul_eq (IsUnit.mk0 _ hpos.ne') _
  · rw [dist_comm (midpoint ℝ A D), dist_comm A B, dist_comm D C, dist_eq_norm_vsub V (midpoint ℝ B C), dist_eq_norm_vsub V B A,
      dist_eq_norm_vsub V C D, hMN, ← hk, norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hpos.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg hkpos.le]
    ring
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C D : P), A ≠ C → (line[ℝ, A, C]).SOppSide B D → (line[ℝ, A, B]).Parallel line[ℝ, D, C] → (line[ℝ, midpoint ℝ A D, midpoint ℝ B C]).Parallel line[ℝ, A, B] ∧ dist (midpoint ℝ A D) (midpoint ℝ B C) = (dist A B + dist D C) / 2
